subject: remove extra space and tweak titles (spacing, underscores)

messages.author: de80823ab00b5d5b
messages.subject: remove extra space and tweak titles (spacing, underscores)
parts:
Hi Group,

Here is an example.

myDF <- structure(list(Group = structure(1:2, .Label = c("A name",
"Another name"
), class = "factor"), coef = c(-6L, 6L), lower = c(-7, 4), upper = c(-4L,
9L)), .Names = c("Group", "coef", "lower", "upper"), class =
"data.frame", row.names = c(NA,
-2L))

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(data=myDF,aes(x=Group,y=coef,min=lower,max=upper))
p <- p + geom_pointrange(size=1)
p <- p + scale_y_continuous(expression("Want this centered
"*Underscore[2]*" Too"))
p <- p + scale_x_discrete("")
p <- p + coord_flip()
p <- p + opts(title = expression("Want this centered "*Underscore[2]*" Too"))


I have a couple of problems with this plot. First, I have extra space
on the left. I removed the axis title using scale_x_discrete("") .
Should

p <- p + opts( axis.title.x=theme_blank())

work? It did not for me. Maybe the extra space is there because it has
still made room for an axis title. Second, I need the main title and
the axis title to have an underscore. As you can see I have it, but I
cannot get either label centered. The lack of centering may not look
strange in this example, but in my actual plot, it does. So I am
seeking some suggestions on how to tweak this. Thanks for your help.

Juliet
